name: saaskit
description: Enterprise auth for B2B apps without writing protocols — login, sessions, SSO, SCIM, MCP OAuth, and RBAC in one stack.

interface.shortDescription: Enterprise auth for B2B apps without writing protocols — login, sessions, SSO, SCIM, MCP OAuth, and RBAC in one stack.
interface.longDescription:
Every enterprise feature request — SSO, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, MCP server auth — is a different protocol to implement correctly. One wrong call in a token validation flow or session lifecycle and you're debugging auth at 2am instead of shipping.

SaaSKit handles the full auth stack: hosted login pages, session management, enterprise SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Google), SCIM provisioning, MCP OAuth, and API key management. Add auth in ~100 lines. Any framework, any stack. Focus on your core product.
